component.name: CachyOS Package Installer
component.summary: Install, remove and update apps and packages

description.p: A small app store for CachyOS. Browse, install, remove and update packages from the CachyOS and Arch repositories, with icons and descriptions from the AppStream catalog.

Packages from the Arch User Repository can be searched and built after opting in. The PKGBUILD and the scripts shipped with a package are shown before a build, and an automatic check marks the lines that deserve a closer look.

ul.li: Reads the package databases directly, nothing runs as root until you confirm
Shows what will be installed or removed before every operation
Lists updates for repository and AUR packages

description.p: Rewritten as a QML application with AUR support and a PKGBUILD check.
